new_controller_scope.persisted_target_occurrences: Every physical regenerated occurrence whose ID appears in any archived span row, including invalid/conflicting/hash/citation-mismatched ledger identities
new_controller_scope.remaining_source_occurrences: Transactional aggregate accounting, byte/length cohorts, rolling digest, bounded identity-only examples; full unarchived row inventory is deliberately not persisted

open_verification: Committed new iterator/controller/CLI sources and focused tests
Fresh-process interruption/resume equivalence and seed-reuse result receipts
Measured bounded resource and actual scan accounting
Current remote main retention before publication

required_invariants.acceptance: Compare all candidate source IDs/digests/ordinals to the old iterator across the 63/64/65 valid-document boundary, including null-CID and citation-fallback records.
required_invariants.requirement: Global span ordinal accumulates within each group of 64 historically valid records independently of pager batch size. Null-CID metadata consumes no valid-document or span ordinal. Real-CID records with raw blank text retain historical USCodeParquetRecord citation fallback and consume its ordinals.

required_invariants.acceptance: Byte/hash-equivalent old/new iterator fixtures including Unicode and source references; explicit fallback source_text_origin and raw_source_text_present=False.
required_invariants.requirement: Preserve the exact historical normalized sentence bytes for span identity; bind original section source artifact/row separately. Unicode, punctuation, whitespace, citation fallback and duplicate occurrences must not be silently changed or deduplicated.

required_invariants.acceptance: Single section exceeding previous 8192-span batch limit is paged; page byte/candidate limits enforced; invalid first oversized candidate does not advance cursor.
required_invariants.requirement: Generate at most one bounded page of candidate dictionaries plus one pending candidate; a full historical sentence list remains bounded by max_section_bytes. Candidate and section byte overflow fail before durable progress.

required_invariants.acceptance: Fault injection before commit rolls back rows, counters, digest and cursor; resumed fresh process matches uninterrupted output under different page limits.
required_invariants.requirement: Persist next_section and next_span atomically with target occurrence rows, aggregate counts, rolling digest and seed state. next_span is zero when a section completes.

required_invariants.acceptance: Duplicate source/CID/text and duplicated/conflicting/invalid archive ledger rows preserve distinct occurrence and ledger denominators.
required_invariants.requirement: Every physical candidate contributes exactly once. target_occurrence_count + unarchived_occurrence_count equals all_source_occurrence_count. Report archived ledger physical rows, distinct IDs, matched source occurrences and matching archived rows separately.

required_invariants.acceptance: Full scan, mid-section stop/resume, section-boundary resume and changed page limits produce exactly the same terminal digest and accounting.
required_invariants.requirement: Digest covers every candidate in canonical physical source order, including unarchived candidates, with stable domain and serialization. Page size, target filtering, counters, timing and other execution choices cannot change it.

required_invariants.acceptance: Wrong seed hash, report, cursor, occurrence field, source/queue pin or active writer refuses before prefix import. Seed import and imported marker commit together.
required_invariants.requirement: Read-only seed bytes are authenticated under a shared stopped-writer lock with WAL absent. Require exact old manifest/input/code bindings and report/state agreement. Reconstruct the entire 18342-occurrence prefix through the new pager and compare every original census._occurrence field, both matched and unlisted, before importing.

required_invariants.acceptance: Five old source pins remain unchanged; old v1 resume remains supported; old seed snapshots and original assets remain byte-identical.
required_invariants.requirement: Implement new iterator/controller/CLI as additive owners. Do not edit the five old v1 source-code owners, overwrite old DB or modify old model/cache checkpoints.

required_invariants.acceptance: All reports retain model/inference/training/admitted/formalized/proof flags false; original asset identity and IR family/dimension/schema/task inventories are unaffected.
required_invariants.requirement: Source identity matching is neither semantic/schema/task compatibility nor model training or formal/proof admission. Legacy citation fallback is provenance rather than genuine statutory text.

required_invariants.acceptance: Report cursor/end-of-source witness, physical sections, exclusions, fallback counts and unresolved archive identities separately.
required_invariants.requirement: Source scan is complete only after exhausting the pinned raw source rows, including metadata exclusions. Completion can retain unresolved archived identities. A target subset fully joined early is not whole-source completion.

resolved_conceptual_questions.question: Should all-candidate v1 seed be reduced to matched rows only?
resolved_conceptual_questions.resolution: Persist only archived-target rows in new inventory, but replay and count/digest all 18342 seed candidates before importing; filtering must not change prefix coverage.

resolved_conceptual_questions.question: Should blank raw-text real-CID rows be skipped?
resolved_conceptual_questions.resolution: No. Preserve the actual historical citation fallback for ordinal compatibility and identify the fallback explicitly. Null-CID metadata remains excluded.

resolved_conceptual_questions.question: Can paged extraction replace existing v1 source files?
resolved_conceptual_questions.resolution: No. Add separately pinned owners; the old seed manifest binds those exact five file hashes.
